latestVersion.changelog:
feishu-voice-sender-v2 v1.0.0

- Initial release.
- Automatically detects channel type (Feishu, Telegram, Discord) and selects the appropriate voice message sending method.
- Feishu channels: generates voice using Xiaomi MiMo TTS and sends native Feishu voice messages.
- Other channels: sends text or voice messages in supported formats.
- Supports various voice styles, dialects, and audio effects via MiMo TTS.
- Requires configuration of MIMO_API_KEY and ffmpeg for audio processing.
